title: Producer (Municipal)
description: Producer fields specific to municipal waste. organisationName and address are required; sicCode is optional. At least one of emailAddress or phoneNumber must be provided. Exactly one of authorisationNumber or reasonForNoAuthorisationNumber must be provided.

wasteSource.description: Waste originates from a municipal source.

authorisationNumber.description: Producer environmental permit or exemption number, in a valid UK format. Mutually exclusive with reasonForNoAuthorisationNumber — exactly one of the two is required.

reasonForNoAuthorisationNumber.description: Reason no authorisationNumber is held. Free text for now — enum values TBC pending BA/policy input. Mutually exclusive with authorisationNumber — exactly one of the two is required.

emailAddress.description: Producer contact email address. At least one of emailAddress or phoneNumber must be provided.

phoneNumber.description: Producer contact phone number, in a valid format. At least one of emailAddress or phoneNumber must be provided.

postcode.description: Accepts UK postcodes and Irish Eircodes.
